name: go-style
description: Go coding-style checks (mechanical + banword + NAK lens + gRPC lens) for opted-in Go repositories

modes.default: full range: all commits in merge-base..HEAD + full diff
modes.staged: staged diff only; commit-msg checks skipped
modes.commit-msg: the message being composed; diff checks skipped

scope: baseline-only (no strict upstream-submit equivalent for this repo)
repo_config_expected: .golangci.yml alongside go.mod in the opted-in repo; optional .go-style-banwords at the repo root
